root_cause.text: The `riscv_iommu_iotlb_inval` function in the RISC-V IOMMU driver performs arithmetic operations on the invalidation range without overflow checks, causing an integer overflow and subsequent infinite loop when the end address of the range is `ULONG_MAX`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the overflow-prone length calculation `len = end - start + 1` with `end - start < RISCV_IOMMU_IOTLB_INVAL_LIMIT - 1` and replaces the standard `for` loop incrementing `iova` with a `do-while` loop that explicitly checks for overflow using `check_add_overflow(iova, PAGE_SIZE, &iova)`.
